Both prior findings are resolved for this scoped checkpoint. No material blocker remains; the candidate validation completed during inspection.

- **Finding 1 — resolved.** [Teardown ordering](/home/andy/projects/monome-emulator-behaviour-audio-crow/.runtime/screen-shutdown-01/norns/matron/src/main.c:47) closes Lua, drains/joins the screen worker, then destroys display and result resources. The [worker](/home/andy/projects/monome-emulator-behaviour-audio-crow/.runtime/screen-shutdown-01/norns/matron/src/screen_events.c:49) releases its queue lock before joining and exits only after draining; I found no introduced ownership or deadlock issue. The baseline records destruction during blocked paint; the [burst8 candidate](/home/andy/projects/monome-emulator-behaviour-audio-crow/artifacts/behaviour-expansion/screen-shutdown-20260908-212017/report.json) records **16 completed paints before destruction**, clean exit and no timeout. The harness has explicit barrier/request/process deadlines. [Validation](/home/andy/projects/monome-emulator-behaviour-audio-crow/artifacts/behaviour-expansion/screen-worker-validation.json:2) now reports `passed-scoped-native-checks`: generic, hotplug, ASan ownership and all three JF cases passed; their candidate matron exits were clean.

- **Finding 2 — resolved.** [Quiet-interval and export checks](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/jf_oracle.py:21) restrict startup/selection to mode setup/reset and exported cleanup to reset only. [Scenario wiring](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/output_cases.py:155) accounts for previously discarded intervals. [Negative tests](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/test_jf_oracle.py:39) inject valid-metadata transition/final packets and require rejection. Recorded evidence reports 9/9 unit tests; I verified the referenced native manifest hashes and successful exits.

**CONFIDENCE: High.** Read-only source/evidence review; no tests launched. This establishes the bounded fixes, not exclusive crash causality, X00/full-campaign admission, absolute audio timing or refactor readiness.
